messages:
Maya (CS): Weekly check-in for AsterSupply 1: error-rate snapshot and top failing endpoints. Overall error rate: 1.6% (up 0.4ppt WoW). Quick split: 5xx = 0.62 (39% of errors), Timeouts = 0.51 (32%), 429s = 0.47 (29%).

Maya (CS): Top endpoints by error volume (7d):
- POST /v1/generate 1: mostly timeouts at p95/p99 during batch jobs around 02:00-04:00 UTC.
- POST /v1/embeddings/batch 1: 429s from burst parallelism when client retries without jitter.
- POST /v1/chat/stream 1: 502s on long sessions (>1500 tokens) after switching to model-z-quant.
- GET /v1/health/agent 1: intermittent 500s from agent restart loops on host pool-91.

Leo (SRE): dug into logs 1: `env:prod service:api status:502 path:/v1/chat/stream | group_by host | count()` 1: host pool-91 had ~70% of 502s last night. Also saw backlog full signals on grpc-worker queues.

Leo (SRE): Hypothesis: model-z-quant path triggers a fallback to slower exec that stalls kv-cache, creating head-of-line waits and timeouts for generate/chat. Embeddings 429s are client-driven bursts from scheduled ETL with no rate-limits.

Sam (Platform): I can add a short-term per-account burst window and increase worker concurrency on pool-91. Also can patch gateway to add exponential jitter for retries for AsterSupply. Will apply a temporary rate-limit rule scoped to the account.

monitor-bot: Applied policy: rate-limit override for acct:aster-supply -> 300 req/min burst 75. Change-id: rl-aster-2026-03-21-a.

Ruth (ENG): For the model-z-quant issue I opened PR #3589 to adjust kernel fallback thresholds and reduce blocking on kv cache. If we can't land quickly, recommend reverting AsterSupply to model-z-fp for the canary.

Leo (SRE): Action plan:
1) Sam to apply burst window + gateway retry jitter (in flight).
2) If 5xx > baseline in 20m we rollback canary for this account to model-z-fp.
3) Ruth to prioritize PR for kernel threshold.
4) Maya to notify customer with ETA + transient credits offer.

Maya (CS): Noted. I'll send a brief customer update: apology, mitigation steps, timeline for rollback/patch, and offer 2 weeks of overage credit if behavior persists.

Sam (Platform): Patch rolled out for account scoping; increased pool-91 worker target +20% temporarily. Monitoring dashboards now include per-account 95/99 charts.

Leo (SRE): After patch: 5xx down ~48% on /v1/chat/stream, timeouts on /v1/generate reduced at p95, still seeing some 429 tail from embeddings at midday window.

Ruth (ENG): PR #3589 ready for review, includes improved async eviction for kv cache. If merged, should reduce head-of-line blocking.

Maya (CS): Summary of immediate items:
- Sam: keep rate-limit override and monitor for 4 hours.
- Leo: prepare rollback plan + runbook if canary issues resurface.
- Ruth: land PR and coordinate hotfix if needed.
- Maya: customer comms + credit offer.

Maya (CS): Closing note: will include this thread in weekly account-health deck. Ping me with :thumbsup: when items are done. Thanks everyone.
